Assumption_Register.title: One marketplace per tenant
Assumption_Register.statement: Lucie MVP uses exactly one MarketplaceContext per tenant.

Assumption_Register.title: M00 v1.1 remains controlled
Assumption_Register.statement: Platform changes enter only through approved proposed M00 deltas.

Assumption_Register.title: M05 v1.0 remains controlled
Assumption_Register.statement: Organization and hierarchy changes enter only through approved proposed M05 deltas.

Assumption_Register.title: M01 is protected
Assumption_Register.statement: Protected Release 1 history and identifiers remain immutable and changes are append-only.

Assumption_Register.title: M03 supplies product readiness
Assumption_Register.statement: M04 does not own plans, service areas or publishing readiness.

Assumption_Register.title: M06 and M08 supply seller readiness
Assumption_Register.statement: M04 does not own affiliation, licensing, appointments or sellability.

Assumption_Register.title: M13 owns files
Assumption_Register.statement: M04 stores asset and document references while approved platform services control binary files.

Assumption_Register.title: M10 owns final communications
Assumption_Register.statement: M04 supplies brand, language, support and attribution context.

Assumption_Register.title: English and Spanish launch together
Assumption_Register.statement: An activated public pathway cannot be incomplete in Spanish.

Assumption_Register.title: JET controls public edge
Assumption_Register.statement: Agencies do not administer certificates, edge routing or infrastructure secrets.

Assumption_Register.title: Fixed routing is sufficient for MVP
Assumption_Register.statement: Round-robin, AI and skills-based assignment are deferred.

Assumption_Register.title: Activation inputs arrive later
Assumption_Register.statement: Pilot domain, tenant, legal text and real provider or product readiness are activation inputs, not packet blockers.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M04 business rule 001
Business_Rule_Register.statement: Each tenant has exactly one MarketplaceContext.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M04 business rule 002
Business_Rule_Register.statement: A MarketplaceContext belongs to exactly one M05 tenant and owner organization.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M04 business rule 003
Business_Rule_Register.statement: The marketplace owner equals the effective M05 tenant-owning organization.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M04 business rule 004
Business_Rule_Register.statement: A marketplace has no more than one ACTIVE coordinated release.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M04 business rule 005
Business_Rule_Register.statement: A marketplace has no more than one editable DRAFT coordinated release.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M04 business rule 006
Business_Rule_Register.statement: A marketplace has exactly one ACTIVE primary production domain when publicly active.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M04 business rule 007
Business_Rule_Register.statement: A direct downline cannot own an independent Lucie marketplace.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M04 business rule 008
Business_Rule_Register.statement: A referral token is never an authentication or authorization credential.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M04 business rule 009
Business_Rule_Register.statement: Existing journey context takes precedence over a later referral entry.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M04 business rule 010
Business_Rule_Register.statement: No route or availability failure silently changes marketplace, tenant, channel, product, carrier, participant or responsible organization.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M04 business rule 011
Business_Rule_Register.statement: Root public entry defaults responsibility to the root organization.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M04 business rule 012
Business_Rule_Register.statement: Ordinary root agents and staff do not inherit root marketplace administration.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M04 business rule 013
Business_Rule_Register.statement: Participant eligibility never overrides M05 organization or relationship status.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M04 business rule 014
Business_Rule_Register.statement: Agent eligibility never overrides M06 affiliation or M08 authority.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M04 business rule 015
Business_Rule_Register.statement: Marketplace availability never overrides M00 entitlement or M03 product readiness.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M04 business rule 016
Business_Rule_Register.statement: Plan visibility is never manually curated or ranked by M04.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M04 business rule 017
Business_Rule_Register.statement: MarketplaceRelease publication activates all referenced component versions atomically or none.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M04 business rule 018
Business_Rule_Register.statement: Scheduled publication revalidates readiness at effective time.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M04 business rule 019
Business_Rule_Register.statement: Preview never creates canonical business records.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M04 business rule 020
Business_Rule_Register.statement: Public route resolution occurs before personal information collection.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M04 business rule 021
Business_Rule_Register.statement: Unknown or invalid public routes fail closed.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M04 business rule 022
Business_Rule_Register.statement: Brand customization cannot remove language, support, legal or accessibility controls.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M04 business rule 023
Business_Rule_Register.statement: Every root-configurable user-facing text field has English and Spanish content before publication.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M04 business rule 024
Business_Rule_Register.statement: Controlled legal and regulated content cannot be edited by a root agency.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M04 business rule 025
Business_Rule_Register.statement: Historical transactions retain marketplace, release, brand and availability versions.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M04 business rule 026
Business_Rule_Register.statement: A downline referral uses the shared marketplace domain and brand.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M04 business rule 027
Business_Rule_Register.statement: Participant suspension stops new routing and links while preserving historical attribution.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M04 business rule 028
Business_Rule_Register.statement: Root support is the fallback when contextual downline support is unavailable.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M04 business rule 029
Business_Rule_Register.statement: Administrative visibility does not grant regulated selling authority.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M04 business rule 030
Business_Rule_Register.statement: Final transaction and document evidence is not rewritten by marketplace changes.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M04 business rule 031
Business_Rule_Register.statement: Every material mutation writes immutable history, M00 audit and an outbox event atomically.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M04 business rule 032
Business_Rule_Register.statement: Every event consumer is idempotent and duplicate-tolerant.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M04 business rule 033
Business_Rule_Register.statement: Every tenant-scoped table enforces row-level isolation.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M04 business rule 034
Business_Rule_Register.statement: No proposed M00, M05 or M01 delta behavior activates before approval.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M04 business rule 035
Business_Rule_Register.statement: Deployment and public activation remain separate decisions.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M04 business rule 036
Business_Rule_Register.statement: The root agency configures routine marketplace behavior; JET is not the routine operator.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M04 business rule 037
Business_Rule_Register.statement: JET performs initial production activation and may block or override marketplace behavior.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M04 business rule 038
Business_Rule_Register.statement: A direct downline participates only inside the shared root marketplace.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M04 business rule 039
Business_Rule_Register.statement: One coordinated release references exact brand, content, availability, routing, support, domain and disclosure versions.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M04 business rule 040
Business_Rule_Register.statement: Only one future marketplace release may be scheduled at a time.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M04 business rule 041
Business_Rule_Register.statement: A blocked schedule leaves the current active release unchanged.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M04 business rule 042
Business_Rule_Register.statement: A revert creates a new release and never reactivates an old record in place.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M04 business rule 043
Business_Rule_Register.statement: Root self-publication is limited to approved low-risk changes.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M04 business rule 044
Business_Rule_Register.statement: Custom-domain activation always requires JET.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M04 business rule 045
Business_Rule_Register.statement: A custom-domain request does not expose certificate or routing administration.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M04 business rule 046
Business_Rule_Register.statement: Search indexing is disabled for draft, preview, suspended and retired routes.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M04 business rule 047
Business_Rule_Register.statement: Root-configurable custom copy requires English and Spanish before publication.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M04 business rule 048
Business_Rule_Register.statement: JET-controlled legal content is selected by reference and never edited by root agencies.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M04 business rule 049
Business_Rule_Register.statement: One active brand applies across all marketplace channels and workspaces.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M04 business rule 050
Business_Rule_Register.statement: Downline support may be contextual but root support is always the fallback.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M04 business rule 051
Business_Rule_Register.statement: A normal marketplace-direct consumer journey defaults responsibility to root.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M04 business rule 052
Business_Rule_Register.statement: A valid downline link establishes initial responsibility for a new journey only.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M04 business rule 053
Business_Rule_Register.statement: A valid agent link establishes intended assignment only while the agent remains eligible.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M04 business rule 054
Business_Rule_Register.statement: A later referral link does not change an existing journey.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M04 business rule 055
Business_Rule_Register.statement: A referral link never grants access to an existing consumer record.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M04 business rule 056
Business_Rule_Register.statement: A user explicitly confirms a new journey under a different referral context.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M04 business rule 057
Business_Rule_Register.statement: M04 provides no public agent or agency directory.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M04 business rule 058
Business_Rule_Register.statement: Unassigned work enters one logical queue for the responsible organization.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M04 business rule 059
Business_Rule_Register.statement: Root administrators may reassign eligible open work; downlines may assign only within their organization.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M04 business rule 060
Business_Rule_Register.statement: Submitted, signed, externally handed-off and final records cannot use ordinary reassignment.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M04 business rule 061
Business_Rule_Register.statement: Participant suspension invalidates links and new routing immediately.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M04 business rule 062
Business_Rule_Register.statement: Agent readiness loss does not silently assign another agent.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M04 business rule 063
Business_Rule_Register.statement: The same marketplace brand applies to unavailable and suspended public states.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M04 business rule 064
Business_Rule_Register.statement: Marketplace suspension blocks new starts but may preserve safe authenticated record access.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M04 business rule 065
Business_Rule_Register.statement: Marketplace ending never deletes transaction, enrollment, document or audit history.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M04 business rule 066
Business_Rule_Register.statement: State, product and carrier presentation is prospective and never alters historical quote or application evidence.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M04 business rule 067
Business_Rule_Register.statement: M04 never promotes or ranks an individual plan.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M04 business rule 068
Business_Rule_Register.statement: No-ready-product behavior never shows stale or simulated plans.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M04 business rule 069
Business_Rule_Register.statement: An alternative channel is offered only through explicit user choice and disclosure.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M04 business rule 070
Business_Rule_Register.statement: On-exchange entry uses protected M01 rather than a duplicate M04 shopping flow.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M04 business rule 071
Business_Rule_Register.statement: Off-exchange, dental, vision and ICHRA entries remain hidden until their owning dependencies are ready.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M04 business rule 072
Business_Rule_Register.statement: M04 operational counts contain no sensitive consumer details.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M04 business rule 073
Business_Rule_Register.statement: M24 owns historical analytics and conversion reporting.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M04 business rule 074
Business_Rule_Register.statement: Every domain and referral resolution records a correlation ID and user-safe outcome.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M04 business rule 075
Business_Rule_Register.statement: Every public failure avoids disclosure of tenant, participant or configuration existence beyond the approved message.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M04 business rule 076
Business_Rule_Register.statement: Every proposed M00, M05 and M01 delta is a proposal and cannot be treated as current behavior.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M04 business rule 077
Business_Rule_Register.statement: M1D-022 is the canonical protected MarketplaceContext lead seam for M04.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M04 business rule 078
Business_Rule_Register.statement: Phase 1 and North Star context may preserve future seams but cannot expand Lucie scope by implication.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M04 business rule 079
Business_Rule_Register.statement: Production seed and route data is explicitly approved; synthetic preview and QA data remains nonproduction.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M04 business rule 080
Business_Rule_Register.statement: A Critical or High unresolved defect blocks affected marketplace activation.
