Invariant_Register.statement: Each tenant has exactly one MarketplaceContext.
A MarketplaceContext belongs to exactly one M05 tenant and owner organization.
The marketplace owner equals the effective M05 tenant-owning organization.
A marketplace has no more than one ACTIVE coordinated release.
A marketplace has no more than one editable DRAFT coordinated release.
A marketplace has exactly one ACTIVE primary production domain when publicly active.
A direct downline cannot own an independent Lucie marketplace.
A referral token is never an authentication or authorization credential.
Existing journey context takes precedence over a later referral entry.
No route or availability failure silently changes marketplace, tenant, channel, product, carrier, participant or responsible organization.
Root public entry defaults responsibility to the root organization.
Ordinary root agents and staff do not inherit root marketplace administration.
Participant eligibility never overrides M05 organization or relationship status.
Agent eligibility never overrides M06 affiliation or M08 authority.
Marketplace availability never overrides M00 entitlement or M03 product readiness.
Plan visibility is never manually curated or ranked by M04.
MarketplaceRelease publication activates all referenced component versions atomically or none.
Scheduled publication revalidates readiness at effective time.
Preview never creates canonical business records.
Public route resolution occurs before personal information collection.
Unknown or invalid public routes fail closed.
Brand customization cannot remove language, support, legal or accessibility controls.
Every root-configurable user-facing text field has English and Spanish content before publication.
Controlled legal and regulated content cannot be edited by a root agency.
Historical transactions retain marketplace, release, brand and availability versions.
A downline referral uses the shared marketplace domain and brand.
Participant suspension stops new routing and links while preserving historical attribution.
Root support is the fallback when contextual downline support is unavailable.
Administrative visibility does not grant regulated selling authority.
Final transaction and document evidence is not rewritten by marketplace changes.
Every material mutation writes immutable history, M00 audit and an outbox event atomically.
Every event consumer is idempotent and duplicate-tolerant.
Every tenant-scoped table enforces row-level isolation.
No proposed M00, M05 or M01 delta behavior activates before approval.
Deployment and public activation remain separate decisions.

Relationship_Register.rule: Marketplace belongs to exactly one M05 tenant.
Marketplace owner is the M05 tenant-owning root organization.
One active, one draft and historical releases.
Entries express State to Product to Carrier and channel.
Root and enabled direct downlines participate.
Public route resolution is immutable evidence.
Entry contexts are short-lived and non-authorizing.
Journey attribution is append-only and effective-dated.
Each fixed control has a result.
Initial and high-risk publication are reviewed.
Every required consumer has delivery state.
Operational counts contain no consumer detail.
Release changes invalidate stale public context.

Requirement_Register.title: Marketplace as a canonical object
Requirement_Register.statement: M04 is the sole canonical owner of MarketplaceContext, including marketplace identity, tenant and owner references, participating organizations, channels, brand, product presentation, routing, attribution, support identity, disclosures, domains, lifecycle, readiness, effective dates and version history. Other modules may retain the marketplace identifier and version used by a transaction but may not create competing marketplace records.

Requirement_Register.title: One marketplace per tenant
Requirement_Register.statement: Each Lucie tenant has exactly one canonical marketplace and no more than one active production marketplace. Consumer-direct, agent, employer, product, carrier, state and direct-downline variations are represented as governed configuration or context within that marketplace rather than separate marketplaces.

Requirement_Register.title: Marketplace owner
Requirement_Register.statement: Every marketplace has exactly one owning organization. The owner is the M05 tenant-owning root agency for a customer tenant and the JET organization for the JET internal tenant. A direct downline may participate but cannot own an independent marketplace. Ownership changes only through a governed tenant-ownership transition.

Requirement_Register.title: Initial marketplace creation
Requirement_Register.statement: When M05 creates a tenant and root organization, M04 creates one linked DRAFT marketplace with immutable marketplace ID, tenant and owner references, internal code, working display name, English default, eligible M00 channel references, baseline or empty brand, readiness checklist and no public production route. The root completes routine setup; JET only repairs or replaces through an explicit platform operation.

Requirement_Register.title: Marketplace administration authority
Requirement_Register.statement: An authorized root AGENCY_ADMIN may configure identity, brand, support, enabled entitled channels and product lines, routing choices, participant attribution, approved disclosures, domain request, preview, readiness, initial-activation submission, business suspension or reactivation, and history. JET may perform all actions and retains initial production activation, legal and security blocks, domain routing, emergency suspension, final override, owner-transition control and platform reference stewardship. No separate Marketplace Operator role is introduced.

Requirement_Register.title: Downline administration posture
Requirement_Register.statement: A direct downline may view its marketplace participation, enabled channels and product lines, readiness, responsible support and attribution, and may maintain permitted M05 support information or request correction. It cannot change global brand, domain, product visibility, tenant routing, legal disclosures, other participants, provider routes or marketplace lifecycle. Root authority prevails.

Requirement_Register.title: Marketplace participant model
Requirement_Register.statement: The root is always the primary participant. Each active direct downline is an eligible participant that the root explicitly enables. Participation states are NOT_ENABLED, PENDING_READINESS, ENABLED and SUSPENDED. Participation may enable attribution, assignment, assistance and routed work but creates no separate marketplace, storefront, entitlement, provider route, selling authority or affiliation.

Requirement_Register.title: Relationship and participation changes
Requirement_Register.statement: M04 reevaluates participation when M05 creates, activates, suspends, ends or changes a relevant organization or relationship. New downlines are not automatically enabled. Relationship end or downline suspension stops new attribution and routing, preserves historical responsibility, requires explicit open-work treatment and never silently moves submitted or final records.

Requirement_Register.title: Supported channels
Requirement_Register.statement: One marketplace may support any approved subset of CONSUMER_DIRECT, AGENT and EMPLOYER. Separate marketplaces are not created by channel. IFP, dental and vision may use consumer-direct and agent where their pathways are ready; ICHRA employer quoting may use employer and agent. Root administrators may enable only channels commercially entitled and activated by M00.

Requirement_Register.title: Marketplace lifecycle
Requirement_Register.statement: Marketplace lifecycle is fixed to DRAFT, ACTIVE, SUSPENDED and ENDED. Draft supports configuration and preview only; Active permits production only when every applicable dependency and gate passes; Suspended prevents new public journeys; Ended permanently closes new activity and preserves history. Readiness and review remain workflow states, not lifecycle values.

Requirement_Register.title: Marketplace readiness
Requirement_Register.statement: Marketplace readiness is derived separately from lifecycle and evaluates active tenant and owner, valid MarketplaceContext, complete English and Spanish brand content, valid assets and domain, support identity, at least one enabled entitled channel and ready product pathway, product visibility, attribution, routing, disclosure assignment, dependency health and absence of a JET block. Users cannot manually mark failed controls as passed.

Requirement_Register.title: Initial production activation
Requirement_Register.statement: The root submits the completed draft marketplace for initial production activation. JET activates only after confirming readiness, commercial entitlement, route, bilingual and legal content, product and geography readiness, support ownership, security, accessibility, UAT and required M00, M05 and M01 delta disposition. The decision and evidence are recorded; initial activation is never automatic or root-only.

Requirement_Register.title: Business suspension and reactivation
Requirement_Register.statement: After initial activation, a root administrator may suspend the marketplace with a fixed reason, effective date, user-safe unavailable message, active-journey review, confirmation and audit, and may reactivate when readiness passes and no JET block exists. JET may suspend or reactivate for security, legal, contractual, platform or operational reasons and takes precedence. M00 emergency controls may disable individual capabilities without suspending the whole marketplace.

Requirement_Register.title: Suspended-marketplace consumer continuity
Requirement_Register.statement: Marketplace suspension blocks new anonymous entry and new quote, product, employer and marketplace-based agent starts but does not automatically remove safe access to existing saved quotes, applications, enrollment records, documents, required next actions and support for authenticated users. The suspended storefront presents a controlled message and permitted sign-in or record route. Tenant, account, legal or emergency controls may still block access.

Requirement_Register.title: Marketplace ending
Requirement_Register.statement: A root may request ending, but only JET may complete it as part of offboarding or approved transition. Ending requires disposition of open journeys, saved quotes, applications, handoffs, member access, documents, communications, participants, domains, redirects, support, exports, retention, audit and M01 continuity. An ended marketplace accepts no new activity, cannot be routinely reactivated and never deletes transaction or audit history.

Requirement_Register.title: Marketplace replacement and rebranding
Requirement_Register.statement: Brand, support, product presentation and domain changes create effective-dated versions of the same marketplace. A new marketplace is not created for a name, logo, color, support, domain, channel or product-line change. A successor marketplace is considered only for a new tenant, legally distinct owner transition, governed migration or future approved marketplace model. Cloning and parallel production storefronts are excluded.

Requirement_Register.title: Marketplace context persistence
Requirement_Register.statement: The marketplace resolved at journey entry remains attached through anonymous browsing, authentication, household, quote, PlanAI, cart, assistance, application, signature, handoff, documents, communications, enrollment and Member Workspace. Marketplace and relevant release versions are preserved for reconstruction. Later changes do not rewrite the context used by completed transactions.

Requirement_Register.title: Global consumer identity across marketplaces
Requirement_Register.statement: Consumers use one global M00 identity across marketplaces. Entering another storefront changes context only for a new journey and does not merge or move households, quotes, applications, documents, agent relationships or enrollments. The active marketplace brand and responsible agency remain visible. Cross-marketplace transfer requires explicit authorized share, reassignment or handoff.

Requirement_Register.title: JET marketplace parity
Requirement_Register.statement: The JET marketplace uses the same MarketplaceContext, lifecycle, readiness, brand, routing, attribution, disclosure and audit contracts as customer marketplaces. JET is both owner and platform administrator. Differences arise from governed configuration and ownership, not a hardcoded separate application.

Requirement_Register.title: Future marketplace boundary
Requirement_Register.statement: Contracts preserve stable identifiers, ownership, versioning and adapters for future multiple marketplaces per tenant, downline storefronts, employer microsites, carrier-operated marketplaces, marketplace networks, concurrent domains, richer themes, marketplace-specific provider routes and more complex participants. Lucie does not build their screens, routing or operations in this release.

Requirement_Register.title: White-label scope
Requirement_Register.statement: Lucie provides limited controlled white labeling, not a website builder. Root administrators may configure display name, logo, primary and accent colors, optional hero image, headline, short introduction, consumer support identity, public domain and approved footer or attribution. Information architecture, layouts, components, workflows, forms, validation, accessibility and transaction content remain fixed; custom CSS, JavaScript, navigation, pages, forms and agency-authored workflow behavior are excluded.

Requirement_Register.title: One active marketplace brand
Requirement_Register.statement: Each marketplace has one active brand configuration shared across consumer-direct, agent-assisted, employer, account, Member Workspace, unavailable and error surfaces. Separate kits by channel, product, carrier, state, downline, role or segment are excluded.

Requirement_Register.title: Brand administration authority
Requirement_Register.statement: Authorized root administrators configure routine brand changes. Downlines may view the brand and maintain permitted M05 support data only. JET may view, edit, block, revert, replace invalid assets, enforce legal or security restrictions, disable a presentation element or restore the JET baseline. JET is not responsible for routine agency branding.

Requirement_Register.title: Brand asset inventory
Requirement_Register.statement: The MVP asset inventory is one primary logo, one compact or square logo, one favicon and one optional hero image. The platform produces required variants. Per-page galleries, video, animation, campaigns, media libraries, downline assets and carrier themes are excluded. Missing optional assets use an approved baseline, never broken placeholders.

Requirement_Register.title: Color customization
Requirement_Register.statement: The root chooses one primary and one accent color. Lucie derives accessible shades, text, hover, focus and component variants. Success, warning, error, security and status colors remain platform-controlled. Inaccessible combinations cannot be published. No full design-token editor is exposed.

Requirement_Register.title: Typography
Requirement_Register.statement: Lucie uses one JET-approved accessible font family. Agencies cannot upload or select fonts. Brand differentiation comes from logo, approved colors, imagery and marketplace identity, avoiding licensing, layout, accessibility and bilingual-rendering risk.

Requirement_Register.title: Fixed layouts and components
Requirement_Register.statement: All marketplaces use the fixed Lucie layout and component system. Root administrators may populate approved fields and choose limited presentation options but cannot rearrange header or footer, move disclosures, remove support or language controls, alter navigation, hide accessibility controls or replace platform forms. Michael designs one reusable system, not bespoke customer interfaces.

Requirement_Register.title: Marketplace display identity
Requirement_Register.statement: A marketplace may have a consumer-facing display name and tagline plus owning-root display and legal names where required. The marketplace name may differ from legal name, but legal ownership remains available in legal or footer areas. Misleading claims of carrier, government, Exchange or regulated status are prohibited and may be blocked by JET.

Requirement_Register.title: Home-page content
Requirement_Register.statement: The fixed marketplace home includes logo and name, optional hero image, headline, short description, enabled pathway cards, language picker, support, required legal and platform attribution and returning-user sign-in. The root may customize headline and introduction in both languages; workflow buttons, eligibility language, regulated instructions and transaction labels remain system-controlled. No unrestricted marketing-page builder is included.

Requirement_Register.title: Channel presentation
Requirement_Register.statement: Enabled consumer-direct, agent and employer pathways appear through fixed Lucie cards and landing experiences. Root administrators may enable entitled channels, provide short approved bilingual introductions and choose approved imagery or baseline presentation. They cannot redesign flows or create channel types.

Requirement_Register.title: Downline presentation
Requirement_Register.statement: Direct downlines operate under the root marketplace brand and may be shown contextually through responsible agency, assigned agent, support and approved relationship disclosure. They receive no separate theme, hero, domain, logo, navigation or product-presentation system.

Requirement_Register.title: ABox and JET attribution
Requirement_Register.statement: The root agency is the primary brand. ABox or JET attribution may appear in restrained footer, legal, secure sign-in, support or handoff contexts when contractually, legally or operationally required. JET centrally controls mandatory, optional or hidden treatment; roots cannot remove required attribution.

Requirement_Register.title: English and Spanish content
Requirement_Register.statement: Every activated marketplace has complete English and Spanish presentation. Each root-configurable text field requires both languages; custom agency content is not machine translated. Incomplete Spanish cannot route users into English-only experience. An approved bilingual JET baseline is used when custom copy is absent.

Requirement_Register.title: Language selection
Requirement_Register.statement: English is default and a persistent English or Espanol picker applies across browsing, sign-in, shopping, PlanAI, assistance, application, handoff, account and Member Workspace. After authentication, the M00 profile preference is authoritative. Language changes do not restart or change marketplace, responsible agency or saved data.

Requirement_Register.title: General marketplace copy
Requirement_Register.statement: Root administrators may edit limited non-regulated plain text or safe-format fields: headline, introduction, channel introductions, support introduction and agency description, subject to length and content rules. Scripts, embedded apps, unsupported HTML, tracking pixels, pricing or eligibility claims and unapproved affiliation claims are prohibited. JET may block misleading or unsafe content.

Requirement_Register.title: Legal and regulated content
Requirement_Register.statement: JET controls legal, privacy, consent, eligibility, enrollment, PlanAI and regulated content through an approved bilingual library. Roots may select applicable approved items or variants and supply required references but may not rewrite controlled text. Accepted disclosures retain the exact content version and language presented.

Requirement_Register.title: Content and brand versions
Requirement_Register.statement: Brand and content versions use DRAFT, ACTIVE and SUPERSEDED. One active and one editable draft are allowed, with unlimited historical superseded versions. Draft preview does not affect production. Publishing creates a new active version and preserves history for audit and transaction reconstruction.

Requirement_Register.title: Brand publishing authority
Requirement_Register.statement: JET performs initial marketplace activation. After launch, roots may self-publish ordinary low-risk brand and general-copy changes when both languages, assets, accessibility, legal-content integrity and readiness pass and no JET block exists. JET approval remains required for initial activation, custom-domain activation, ownership change, material regulated content, reviewed changes and restoration after JET suspension. No configurable approval workflow is added.

Requirement_Register.title: Scheduled brand changes
Requirement_Register.statement: A root may publish immediately or schedule one future effective date and time. Repeating schedules, audience targeting, percentage rollout, A/B tests, seasonal campaign calendars and multiple queued brand versions are excluded. JET may cancel or delay a blocked schedule.

Requirement_Register.title: Marketplace preview
Requirement_Register.statement: Private preview supports English and Spanish, consumer, agent and employer entry, desktop, tablet and mobile, draft assets and content, support, disclosures, unavailable, suspended and error states. Preview is visibly nonproduction, not indexed and cannot create quotes, applications, messages, signatures or handoffs.

Requirement_Register.title: Public domain options
Requirement_Register.statement: Each marketplace may use a default JET-managed subdomain or an agency-owned custom domain. An agency may move to a custom domain without a new marketplace. Exactly one domain is the primary public production entry.

Requirement_Register.title: Custom-domain administration
Requirement_Register.statement: The root may request a custom domain and is responsible for ownership, external verification, registration maintenance and non-misleading use. JET verifies and activates the route, applies platform security, blocks invalid domains and handles emergencies. Agencies never receive direct routing, certificate, infrastructure or secret administration.

Requirement_Register.title: One primary production domain
Requirement_Register.statement: A marketplace has exactly one active primary production domain. A controlled JET service route, temporary redirect from the previous domain and nonproduction preview routes may coexist without becoming additional marketplaces. Multiple public domains cannot create conflicting identity or tracking contexts.

Requirement_Register.title: Domain change and continuity
Requirement_Register.statement: A domain change creates a new effective route version. JET may redirect a prior controlled route during transition. Existing journeys retain canonical MarketplaceContext and are not duplicated. Sign-in, secure links where valid, record access, audit, bilingual communication and support continuity are preserved.

Requirement_Register.title: Invalid or unavailable domain behavior
Requirement_Register.statement: Unknown, unverified, expired, suspended or incorrectly mapped domains fail closed and never route silently to another agency, JET marketplace, tenant or generic shopping. A controlled unavailable message and approved support route may be shown. Any JET service route must be explicitly configured and identify the correct marketplace.

Requirement_Register.title: Search-engine presentation
Requirement_Register.statement: M04 supports only basic bilingual page title and description, marketplace name, primary domain and approved preview image. Draft, preview and suspended routes are not indexed. Active indexing requires JET enablement. SEO consoles, campaigns, structured-data editing, blogs, landing-page farms and agency tracking scripts are excluded.

Requirement_Register.title: Brand application across Lucie
Requirement_Register.statement: The active brand applies wherever a MarketplaceContext exists: public entry, shopping, authentication presentation, consumer and member workspaces, employer, unavailable and error states, secure links, communications and generated outputs where consuming modules support it. M04 supplies brand and version; M00, M10, M13 and others apply it. SMS uses sender and responsible-agency identity rather than visual styling.

Requirement_Register.title: Historical brand preservation
Requirement_Register.statement: Material transactions retain the marketplace and brand-content version used at the time. Historical documents and communications are not regenerated after logo, color, name, domain, support or copy changes. Current account surfaces may show current support while historical evidence remains unchanged and dated.

Requirement_Register.title: Brand and content enforcement
Requirement_Register.statement: M04 validates every proposed brand and content version. Missing bilingual content, invalid assets, inaccessible colors, prohibited or misleading content, missing support or disclosures, invalid domain and JET legal, security or contractual block prevent publication. JET may suspend or revert serious issues while exposing reason, corrective action and prior valid version to the root.

Requirement_Register.title: Future white-label boundary
Requirement_Register.statement: Contracts preserve future seams for multiple brand kits, downline storefronts, employer microsites, carrier brands, custom fonts, richer themes, content pages, campaigns, banners, multiple domains, A/B testing, custom analytics and marketplace-specific communication templates. The MVP implements none of those simply because it is called white labeling.

Requirement_Register.title: Marketplace availability decision
Requirement_Register.statement: A marketplace product pathway is presented only when tenant, marketplace, M00 commercial activation, product-line entitlement, channel entitlement, marketplace channel and product visibility, launch geography, M03 product and plan readiness, carrier pathway readiness, participant readiness, M08 authority, provider and integration readiness, feature controls, launch gates and absence of a JET block all pass. M04 composes the final presentation decision but does not duplicate any source module calculation.

Requirement_Register.title: Fixed Lucie product-line catalogue
Requirement_Register.statement: The fixed Lucie product-line catalogue is IFP_ON_EXCHANGE, IFP_OFF_EXCHANGE, DENTAL, VISION and ICHRA_EMPLOYER_QUOTING. Root agencies cannot create, rename or reclassify canonical product lines. Future ancillary or custom products require governed downstream expansion.

Requirement_Register.title: Product-visibility granularity
Requirement_Register.statement: Root administrators configure marketplace visibility only at State, Product line and Carrier levels. They do not curate plan by plan. When a carrier is enabled for a state and product line, every M03-published plan that passes channel, geography, effective-date, legal and readiness controls is eligible. JET may block an individual product or plan for a governed issue.

Requirement_Register.title: Carrier selection
Requirement_Register.statement: Root administrators select only JET-controlled carrier organizations with ready product data for the applicable state and product line. Carrier presentation does not create appointments, contracts, integrations, commissions or selling authority and cannot override M08 or downstream readiness.

Requirement_Register.title: State product-line and carrier matrix
Requirement_Register.statement: M04 exposes one simple State to Product line to Carrier availability matrix. A root may enable an approved state, an entitled product line and ready carriers. The UI explains blockers. Arbitrary Boolean rules, county-authored rules, consumer-segment or household rules, date formulas, custom eligibility expressions and scripting are excluded.

Requirement_Register.title: Geography model
Requirement_Register.statement: One marketplace may serve multiple JET-approved launch states. The root selects only approved states for its tenant. Separate state marketplaces, brands, domains, root-authored counties, service areas or geography definitions are excluded. M03 service-area data controls exact plan geography.

Requirement_Register.title: Consumer service-area resolution
Requirement_Register.statement: Before exact products are shown, the user provides the minimum location data required by the pathway. Approved geography and M03 service-area data resolve state, county or rating area, service area, carriers and plans. Roots cannot force plans outside their published service area. Unresolvable location enters a clear correction flow rather than estimated availability.

Requirement_Register.title: Supported channel and product combinations
Requirement_Register.statement: Supported combinations are fixed: on-exchange IFP supports consumer-direct and agent; off-exchange IFP supports consumer-direct and agent when ready; dental and vision support consumer-direct and agent when M21 and dependent pathways are ready; ICHRA employer quoting supports employer and agent and is not consumer-direct in the initial Lucie scope. New combinations require governed change.

Requirement_Register.title: Marketplace channel control
Requirement_Register.statement: The root may enable or disable commercially entitled CONSUMER_DIRECT, AGENT and EMPLOYER channels. Disabling removes new public entry but preserves existing journeys and evidence. JET may disable a channel for legal, product, integration, security, contractual or release reasons. A root cannot enable an unentitled or inactive channel.

Requirement_Register.title: Product-line control
Requirement_Register.statement: The root may enable or disable an entitled product line within each enabled state. Disablement is prospective: it stops new entries and removes public presentation while preserving quotes, applications, documents, handoffs, enrollment and coverage. Reenablement requires current readiness.

Requirement_Register.title: Carrier disablement
Requirement_Register.statement: The root may stop presenting a carrier for new activity by state and product line. Existing quotes, submitted applications, coverage, documents, external results and historical attribution remain unchanged. JET may immediately disable a carrier or product for compliance, data or operational risk.

Requirement_Register.title: No marketplace-controlled plan ranking
Requirement_Register.statement: M04 does not permit manual plan ranking, sponsorship, promotion or individual-plan suppression by a root agency. Ordering, comparison and recommendation remain with M01, M02 and PlanAI. Carrier visibility cannot imply recommendation. Paid placement and offer ranking remain future downstream boundaries.

Requirement_Register.title: Product availability version
Requirement_Register.statement: Marketplace availability configuration is versioned independently using DRAFT, ACTIVE and SUPERSEDED. There is one active version, one editable draft and historical superseded versions. Publishing creates a new active version and preserves the configuration used by earlier journeys and transactions.

Requirement_Register.title: Effective-date scheduling
Requirement_Register.statement: A root may publish an approved availability version immediately or at one future effective date and time. Recurring schedules, multiple queued versions, percentage rollouts, audience or household targeting and date formulas are excluded. JET may delay or cancel a blocked activation.

Requirement_Register.title: Public product presentation before quoting
Requirement_Register.statement: The public marketplace may show high-level categories before account creation, but it cannot promise a specific carrier or plan before required location and shopping information is collected. Exact plans, prices, subsidies, benefits and eligibility are displayed only through the governed shopping or quoting pathway.

Requirement_Register.title: Hidden versus unavailable presentation
Requirement_Register.statement: Ordinary users see only enabled channels and product lines. A deep link to an unavailable pathway shows a controlled, marketplace-branded unavailable state with an approved next action and no internal configuration detail. Root and JET administrators see potential pathways and their entitlement, product, geography, carrier, participant, integration and launch blockers.

Requirement_Register.title: No generic coming-soon catalogue
Requirement_Register.statement: Unavailable products, states, carriers and channels are not shown as coming soon by default. JET may approve an accurate bilingual informational message that avoids unsupported dates, distinguishes interest from active shopping and does not collect application data. M04 is not a wait-list or launch-marketing platform.

Requirement_Register.title: No silent fallback
Requirement_Register.statement: M04 never silently changes marketplace, marketplace context, exchange posture, channel, responsible agency, carrier or real-versus-estimated availability when a requested pathway is unavailable. Any alternative requires explicit user choice.

Requirement_Register.title: Alternative-channel offer
Requirement_Register.statement: When self-service is unavailable but an approved agent-assisted path exists in the same marketplace, Lucie may explicitly offer assistance, scheduling, an available or assigned agent and permitted data preservation. The experience explains the channel change, assisting agency, data access, authorization and any re-entry requirement before the user accepts.

Requirement_Register.title: Switching between consumer-direct and agent assistance
Requirement_Register.statement: A consumer may explicitly move from self-service to agent assistance within the same marketplace. Where permitted, marketplace, identity, household, geography, product line, quote inputs and quote or cart reference are preserved. Actual actor, consumer authorization, responsible organization, assigned agent and marketplace and availability versions remain historical. M01, M02 and M09 own detailed assistance and assignment behavior.

Requirement_Register.title: On-exchange IFP entry
Requirement_Register.statement: When on-exchange IFP is enabled, M04 enters the protected M01 journey with marketplace and release, tenant, responsible organization, channel, state, language, attribution, support and product-line context. M01 remains authoritative for quote, comparison, PlanAI, cart, consent and JET EDE handoff; M04 does not duplicate shopping.

Requirement_Register.title: On-exchange and off-exchange choice
Requirement_Register.statement: When both on-exchange and off-exchange IFP are active, Lucie presents a fixed plain-language choice distinguishing Marketplace shopping that may include financial assistance from direct purchase without Marketplace financial assistance. M04 does not promise subsidy eligibility, determine legal eligibility, automatically select a path or hide material differences.

Requirement_Register.title: Off-exchange IFP pathway
Requirement_Register.statement: Off-exchange IFP may be configured in M04 but remains hidden from production until M02, M26, carrier, document, signature and integration dependencies are ready. Once active, it uses the same marketplace brand, language, support and attribution contracts. No temporary substitute application or simulated production outcome is allowed.

Requirement_Register.title: Dental and vision pathways
Requirement_Register.statement: Dental and vision visibility may be configured but remains unavailable until M21, M02, M26 and carrier pathways are ready. M04 controls category, state, carrier and channel presentation; M21 and shopping and enrollment owners determine standalone, bundled, add-on and application behavior. M04 does not invent bundling.

Requirement_Register.title: ICHRA employer pathway
Requirement_Register.statement: When ICHRA employer quoting is enabled, M04 presents employer and agent entry into M20 and supplies marketplace, tenant, responsible organization, channel, language, support, geography and release context. M20 owns employer identity, quote, employee or class structure, contributions, workflow and final availability. ICHRA is not consumer-direct in initial Lucie.

Requirement_Register.title: Participant readiness and product availability
Requirement_Register.statement: An agent-assisted pathway is available only when at least one appropriate organization and workforce participant can support the product, carrier, geography and channel. M04 consumes M05 participation, M06 affiliation and readiness and M08 authority but does not calculate sellability. If no eligible seller exists, the pathway is blocked or sent to approved root support rather than falsely shown as available.

Requirement_Register.title: Consumer-direct participant posture
Requirement_Register.statement: A consumer-direct journey does not require agent selection when the pathway supports unassisted activity. The marketplace still records owner, responsible organization, support identity and attribution. If a legal, carrier or pathway rule requires a producer, the path remains unavailable until a valid assignment exists.

Requirement_Register.title: No-ready-products behavior
Requirement_Register.statement: When no ready products exist for the selected geography, product line, channel and marketplace, Lucie presents a clear no-options result and may offer location correction, another enabled category, assistance, support or return-later. It never displays stale, cross-state, cross-marketplace or simulated plans. Administration exposes the actual canonical blocker.

Requirement_Register.title: Product-pathway preview
Requirement_Register.statement: Root and JET administrators may preview product and channel availability using approved state, product, channel, participant, language and ready or blocked conditions. Preview uses read-only or test data, is clearly nonproduction and cannot create consumers, quotes, applications, messages, assignments or handoffs.

Requirement_Register.title: Historical availability preservation
Requirement_Register.statement: Every material journey and transaction retains the marketplace availability version used at start or relevant selection. Later changes do not silently alter quote contents, product line, carrier, channel, responsible organization, application, signature, handoff or enrollment. Resuming an old unfinished journey clearly identifies if refresh or restart is required by the owning module.

Requirement_Register.title: Marketplace participant types
Requirement_Register.statement: Marketplace participants are the tenant-owning root agency, root-enabled direct downline agencies and workforce users or agents associated through M06. Organizations are canonical participants; agents and staff participate through M00 identity, M06 affiliation and M08 authority. M04 creates no marketplace-specific agency identity, agent profile, storefront entity, custom participant type or relationship graph.

Requirement_Register.title: Root-agency participation
Requirement_Register.statement: The root agency is always the primary participant, marketplace owner, primary brand, default support organization, recipient of unassigned work, overseer of direct downlines and continuity provider when a participant is unavailable. It cannot remove itself while it owns the tenant.

Requirement_Register.title: Direct-downline eligibility
Requirement_Register.statement: A direct downline is eligible only when its M05 organization and PARENT_OF relationship are active, the root enables participation, an active administrator exists, required M06 profile and support readiness passes, applicable channel and product readiness passes and no M00, M05, M08, legal or JET block exists. Eligibility is reevaluated whenever a dependency changes.

Requirement_Register.title: Participant configuration
Requirement_Register.statement: Each eligible downline has a fixed participant record with participation state, effective dates, consumer-assistance, agent and employer channel participation, responsible-agency display preference, support-identity preference, referral-link availability and current readiness. Custom fields, participant-authored routing or participant-specific product catalogues are excluded.

Requirement_Register.title: Agent participation boundary
Requirement_Register.statement: An agent may participate only with an active M00 account, active M06 affiliation and workforce profile, applicable M08 license, appointment, credential and sellability, required assignment or assistance basis and no suspension or JET block. M04 consumes the eligible-agent result and never calculates authority.

Requirement_Register.title: Marketplace attribution roles
Requirement_Register.statement: M04 distinguishes marketplace owner, entry-attribution organization, current responsible organization, assigned agent, selling organization and producer, and current support organization. These roles may coincide but are never assumed equivalent. Historical records preserve each role and the governing source.

Requirement_Register.title: Default consumer-direct responsibility
Requirement_Register.statement: A new consumer-direct journey through the normal public domain defaults to the root as responsible organization and remains self-service unless a producer is required. The root may retain, assign assistance, reassign eligible open work to a downline or respond to assistance requests. Normal public entries are not automatically distributed among downlines.

Requirement_Register.title: Downline referral links
Requirement_Register.statement: An enabled downline may have one system-generated referral link on the shared marketplace domain and brand. It identifies the downline as entry-attribution and initial responsible organization for a new journey while preserving owner and marketplace. It creates no storefront, domain, record access or selling authority and may be revoked by the downline, root or JET.

Requirement_Register.title: Agent referral links
Requirement_Register.statement: An eligible agent may have one system-generated referral link tied to marketplace, responsible agency, agent, approved channel and optional approved product-line entry. It may establish intended responsibility and assignment for a new journey if eligibility remains valid. It does not grant existing-record access, bypass consent or sellability, guarantee assignment, create an agent storefront or determine commissions.

Requirement_Register.title: Referral-link administration
Requirement_Register.statement: The root may create, view, revoke and replace referral links for root, direct downlines and eligible agents, review status and basic usage, and disable participant links. A downline may manage its own agency and affiliated-agent links. An agent may copy and use an active link but cannot change its organization or marketplace. JET may disable or replace any link.

Requirement_Register.title: Referral links are not security credentials
Requirement_Register.statement: A referral link establishes entry attribution only and is never a credential. Returning consumers must authenticate for protected records, existing responsibility and consent remain controlling, and the referred agency or agent receives no automatic record access. Existing-record access requires a new approved authorization or assignment basis where applicable.

Requirement_Register.title: Invalid or unavailable referral link
Requirement_Register.statement: If a referral link references an unavailable agent or organization, Lucie never silently substitutes another participant. It offers explicit choices such as same agency without named agent, root marketplace, root assistance, home page or support based on readiness. The user's selection determines new responsibility. Marketplace unavailability uses the normal unavailable treatment.

Requirement_Register.title: Existing journey takes precedence
Requirement_Register.statement: An existing saved or active journey retains its marketplace, responsible organization, assigned agent, channel, product line and availability version. A later referral link never silently moves it. The consumer may resume, explicitly start a separate journey in the new context or request a governed transfer or assistance change.

Requirement_Register.title: Signed-in new-journey confirmation
Requirement_Register.statement: A signed-in consumer starting a new journey through a different referral context sees and confirms the marketplace, proposed responsible agency and agent, product line, channel, new-journey status and the fact that existing records will not move before the new journey is created.

Requirement_Register.title: No public agency or agent directory
Requirement_Register.statement: Lucie provides no public agency or agent directory, ratings, specialties, office browsing or availability calendar. A participant is reached through normal marketplace entry, approved referral link, existing assignment, consumer-requested assistance or root-authorized reassignment.

Requirement_Register.title: Fixed routing sequence
Requirement_Register.statement: New-journey routing follows this fixed order: preserve an existing active journey; valid agent referral; valid downline referral; existing authorized relationship confirmed by the owning module; otherwise normal marketplace entry to the root. A later signal never silently overrides an earlier valid governing condition.

Requirement_Register.title: No automatic round-robin in the MVP
Requirement_Register.statement: Lucie does not implement round-robin, weighted, capacity, geographic-radius, performance, language, specialty, commission, AI scoring, calendar or conversion-based routing. Unassigned work enters the responsible organization's fixed logical queue and is assigned through M09, M06 or the owning journey workflow.

Requirement_Register.title: Consumer assistance request
Requirement_Register.statement: A consumer may explicitly request assistance from an eligible self-service journey. Where permitted, the request preserves marketplace, responsibility, identity, household, geography, product, quote inputs, record reference, language and attribution. The user is told which agency receives it, whether an agent exists, which data becomes visible, the required authorization and next step. M01, M02 and M09 own detailed work.

Requirement_Register.title: Responsible-organization queue
Requirement_Register.statement: Each root or enabled downline participant has one logical marketplace queue for assistance requests, unassigned referrals, employer assistance, routing exceptions, unavailable-agent items and reassignment requests. M04 identifies responsible organization and routing reason; M00 owns shared tasks and exceptions; business modules own the work record. Custom marketplace queues are excluded.

Requirement_Register.title: Root assignment authority
Requirement_Register.statement: A root administrator may assign or reassign eligible open marketplace work among the root, direct enabled downlines and eligible agents within the selected responsible organization. Current and proposed responsibility, agent, reason, effective time, required notice, consent review and audit are mandatory. Submitted, signed, handed-off or final records cannot use ordinary reassignment.

Requirement_Register.title: Downline assignment authority
Requirement_Register.statement: A downline administrator may assign or reassign eligible work among eligible agents affiliated with its own organization only. It cannot assign siblings, move work to or from root without root authority, select another agency's agent, override sellability, move final evidence or change marketplace ownership. Root authority may override.

Requirement_Register.title: Agent readiness loss
Requirement_Register.statement: When an assigned or referred agent loses account, affiliation, credential, appointment, sellability or organization readiness, new routing and the referral link stop immediately, open work is flagged, responsibility stays with the organization until governed reassignment, self-service may continue when permitted and producer-required work remains blocked. Historical attribution remains.

Requirement_Register.title: Named agent unavailable experience
Requirement_Register.statement: When a named agent is unavailable, the marketplace explicitly offers same agency without named agent, another eligible agent from that agency, root assistance, self-service where permitted or return home. Another agent is never silently substituted.

Requirement_Register.title: Employer-pathway routing
Requirement_Register.statement: A new employer journey through normal entry defaults to the root. A valid downline or agent referral may establish initial responsibility or assignment when enabled for EMPLOYER. M04 supplies context; M20 owns employer matching, contact authority, quote ownership, assignment and ICHRA workflow. Existing employer work is not changed by a later referral.

Requirement_Register.title: Consumer-facing agency presentation
Requirement_Register.statement: Consumer-facing experiences clearly distinguish marketplace brand, marketplace owner, current responsible agency, assigned agent where applicable and support contact on relevant journey, assistance, quote, application, communication, account, member and handoff surfaces without implying a downline owns a separate marketplace.

Requirement_Register.title: Support-identity hierarchy
Requirement_Register.statement: Every marketplace has a complete bilingual root support identity with display name, phone, secure email or contact route, business hours, support introduction and escalation reference where applicable. An enabled downline may use contextual support sourced from M05 while retaining root marketplace brand and owner attribution. Root may override or replace downline presentation.

Requirement_Register.title: Support fallback
Requirement_Register.statement: Root support is the fixed fallback when no downline is responsible, downline support is incomplete, the downline or relationship is inactive, no active administrator exists or a routing or support exception remains. Stale downline support is never shown. Current root support may be displayed without rewriting historical responsibility.

Requirement_Register.title: Support ownership by issue type
Requirement_Register.statement: Support ownership is lean: responsible agency handles ordinary shopping, quote, assistance and application questions; root handles downline escalation, unassigned work, continuity and marketplace administration; JET handles platform, identity, security, integration and unresolved product defects; authoritative external outcomes route to the relevant carrier, Exchange, employer or provider. Users see one primary route.

Requirement_Register.title: Communications and document attribution
Requirement_Register.statement: M04 supplies M10, M13 and transaction modules with marketplace and brand version, owner, entry attribution, responsible organization, assigned agent, support identity, language and routing version. Communications and outputs use the approved transaction context. Later assignment or support changes do not rewrite sent communications, signed documents or completed evidence.

Requirement_Register.title: Consent and agent record access
Requirement_Register.statement: Entry through an agency or agent referral link does not authorize access to existing consumer records. New journeys may establish responsibility and intended assignment, while existing records require consumer assistance authorization, assignment, takeover, sharing permission or another approved basis preserving purpose, scope, actor, organization, language, version and time.

Requirement_Register.title: Attribution and assignment history
Requirement_Register.statement: Each marketplace journey retains append-only history of entry source, marketplace, entry-attribution organization, initial and current responsible organization, agent history, selling organization and producer where applicable, support organization, routing and reassignment reason, effective dates, actual actor, consumer authorization and marketplace and routing versions. Reassignment is prospective.

Requirement_Register.title: Fixed entry-source catalogue
Requirement_Register.statement: Entry source is fixed to MARKETPLACE_DIRECT, ROOT_AGENCY_LINK, DOWNLINE_AGENCY_LINK, AGENT_LINK, ROOT_ADMIN_INITIATED, DOWNLINE_ADMIN_INITIATED, EMPLOYER_LINK, EXISTING_AUTHORIZED_RELATIONSHIP and APPROVED_EXTERNAL_REFERRAL. Standard analytics parameters may be retained but never independently control routing or authorization. No custom source builder is included.

Requirement_Register.title: Participant suspension and ending
Requirement_Register.statement: Participant suspension or ending stops new routing, attribution, referral links and agent assignments, flags open work for continuity and permits root reassignment of eligible work while preserving completed history and providing updated support. It does not end or delete the M05 organization and cannot reactivate against inactive M05 state.

Requirement_Register.title: Routing explanation for administrators
Requirement_Register.statement: Root and JET administrators can inspect routing explanation showing entry source, referral link, existing relationship where used, selected organization and agent, eligibility checks, fallback or user choice, routing version and time. Downline administrators see only their records. Consumers receive a simpler who-is-helping and change-request explanation.

Requirement_Register.title: No commission or contract determination
Requirement_Register.statement: M04 attribution, responsibility and routing do not determine commission ownership, revenue sharing, writing hierarchy, book ownership, carrier contract, selling paper, appointment, producer of record or policy-servicing ownership. M04 preserves factual marketplace history for M06, M07, M08, M12, M18 and transaction modules.

Requirement_Register.title: Future routing boundary
Requirement_Register.statement: Contracts preserve future seams for round-robin, weighted, capacity, skill and language matching, proximity, availability calendars, public agent directories, AI lead routing, performance routing, call-center queues, multiple responsible organizations and cross-tenant referrals. None are implemented in Lucie MVP.

Requirement_Register.title: Complete prior-module continuity
Requirement_Register.statement: M04 produces complete impact and proposed append-only delta records for every affected M00, M05 and protected M01 requirement, role, context, screen, API, event, integration, consent, notification, audit, export, migration and regression obligation. No delivered baseline is silently changed.

Requirement_Register.title: Fixed marketplace-administration surfaces
Requirement_Register.statement: M04 provides fixed Marketplace Administration Home, Identity and Brand, Content and Language, Domains and Public Routes, Channels and Availability, Participants and Referral Links, Routing and Support, Readiness, Preview and Publication, and History and Operational Issues surfaces. JET, root and downline actions vary by authority. Custom pages, navigation, dashboards and user-created marketplace sections are excluded.

Requirement_Register.title: Marketplace Administration Home
Requirement_Register.statement: The root Marketplace Administration Home shows lifecycle, domain, active release, draft and scheduled change, channels, states, product lines, carriers, participants, links, readiness, product and participant problems, recent changes, open work and quick actions for preview, edit, publish, suspend and history. It is an operational summary, not a configurable analytics dashboard.

Requirement_Register.title: Guided initial marketplace setup
Requirement_Register.statement: Initial setup follows a fixed guided sequence: identity; assets and colors; English and Spanish content; root support; channels; state, product and carrier availability; downline participation; routing and referral posture; JET subdomain or custom domain; preview; readiness; and submission for initial JET activation. Draft save and resume is supported. No configurable onboarding workflow is included.

Requirement_Register.title: Draft save and resume
Requirement_Register.statement: Marketplace administration automatically preserves draft progress and distinguishes saved draft, unsaved local change, validation problem, readiness blocker, scheduled publication and active production configuration. Only one editable draft exists for each governed configuration stream; competing administrator-owned drafts are excluded.

Requirement_Register.title: Marketplace administration authority
Requirement_Register.statement: Every authorized root AGENCY_ADMIN has the same governed marketplace administration authority. No separate Marketplace Administrator, brand-only or product-only role, per-field permission model or agency-defined approval hierarchy is introduced. M00 may distinguish high-risk operations; downline authority remains limited to approved view and correction requests.

Requirement_Register.title: Coordinated marketplace-release snapshot
Requirement_Register.statement: Brand, availability, routing, participant, support, domain and disclosure records retain their own histories but are published through one coordinated MarketplaceRelease that references their exact versions. There is one active release, one editable draft release and historical superseded releases. Each journey retains the release version used.

Requirement_Register.title: Active-versus-draft comparison
Requirement_Register.statement: Before publication, root and JET administrators compare active and draft values, effective date, affected channels, states, products, carriers, participants, public presentation, support and blockers. The comparison explains business effect, such as which new journeys stop, rather than only raw field differences.

Requirement_Register.title: Marketplace preview modes
Requirement_Register.statement: Private preview supports language, device, consumer, agent or employer entry, state, product line, root or downline attribution, normal or referral entry and ready, blocked, suspended or unavailable state. Selected conditions are visible. Preview is nonproduction and creates no business record.

Requirement_Register.title: Participant-context preview
Requirement_Register.statement: The root may preview normal root entry, selected downline entry, eligible agent referral, named-agent-unavailable and suspended-participant states. Preview shows brand, owner, entry attribution, responsible organization, agent, support and required disclosure without granting or impersonating participant access.

Requirement_Register.title: Publication review and confirmation
Requirement_Register.statement: Before publishing or scheduling, Lucie presents marketplace and tenant, effective time, brand, domain, channel, product, state, carrier, participant, routing, support, legal or disclosure, continuity, blocker, warning and required-approval changes. The administrator confirms the coordinated release; incomplete sections are never published separately.

Requirement_Register.title: Initial activation submission
Requirement_Register.statement: The root submits initial setup to JET. It may correct an unapproved draft, but material changes after review starts return affected items to pending. JET may approve and activate, return for correction, block, request evidence or cancel. No public production route exists until JET activates the first release.

Requirement_Register.title: Post-launch publication
Requirement_Register.statement: After initial activation, roots may publish ordinary low-risk releases when self-publication controls pass. JET approval remains required for domain activation, ownership change, controlled legal content, JET review blocks, restoration after JET suspension and other specifically governed high-risk changes. JET is not required for every logo, color, copy or permitted availability update.

Requirement_Register.title: Scheduled-publication failure
Requirement_Register.statement: A scheduled release is published only if every required readiness condition still passes at the effective time. If blocked, the current active release remains, root and JET are notified, the draft remains correctable or reschedulable and public users never see a partial release.

Requirement_Register.title: Reverting to an earlier valid presentation
Requirement_Register.statement: A root may create a new draft from a prior valid release. JET may immediately restore a prior valid presentation for legal, security or severe operations. Revert creates a new release, preserves replaced history, does not alter past transactions or communications and revalidates current product, route and participant readiness.

Requirement_Register.title: Custom-domain request flow
Requirement_Register.statement: Custom-domain request follows a fixed flow: proposed domain, ownership confirmation, required external steps, verification, preview, continuity review, activation submission and JET activation. Roots never configure certificates, platform routing, infrastructure secrets or DNS automation directly.

Requirement_Register.title: Domain status experience
Requirement_Register.statement: Domain lifecycle is REQUESTED, ACTION_REQUIRED, VERIFIED, ACTIVE, SUSPENDED and RETIRED. Administration shows current state, root and JET actions, verification, primary domain, previous route and redirect, last check and user-safe failure. Only one domain is active as primary public production route.

Requirement_Register.title: Referral-link management experience
Requirement_Register.statement: Referral-link management shows participant, type, responsible organization, assigned agent, channel, optional product entry, status, creation and last use, basic entry count, copy, revoke, replace and readiness. Downlines see only their organization and affiliated-agent links. Campaign building, vanity URL and custom tracking-rule configuration are excluded.

Requirement_Register.title: Participant-management experience
Requirement_Register.statement: Participant management shows M05 organization and relationship status, marketplace participation, channels, link status, support, readiness, blockers, dates and allowed actions. Root may enable, suspend or end participation without changing M05 lifecycle. Custom routing formulas and participant-specific product catalogues are excluded.

Requirement_Register.title: Marketplace operational-health view
Requirement_Register.statement: Root and JET administrators see operational health for lifecycle, release, domain, assets, bilingual content, product and carrier availability, participants, referral links, support, integrations, routing exceptions, propagation and M00, M05 and M01 compatibility gates. Each blocker identifies its canonical owner and is never presented as an editable M04 value when owned elsewhere.

Requirement_Register.title: Fixed marketplace exceptions
Requirement_Register.statement: M04 uses the M00 task and exception framework with fixed types for missing assets, incomplete English or Spanish, inaccessible colors, invalid domain, missing support or disclosure, no entitled channel, no ready product, no eligible participant, invalid link, unavailable participant, routing conflict, blocked schedule, propagation failure, unapproved prior-module delta, suspension review and ending review. Agencies cannot create types.

Requirement_Register.title: Exception ownership and escalation
Requirement_Register.statement: The root owns ordinary brand, general copy, bilingual completion, support, channel, product-presentation, participant, referral, scheduling and root-suspension issues. Canonical source modules own organization, product, affiliation, licensing, document and integration blockers. JET owns domain activation, security and legal blocks, routing infrastructure, initial activation, emergencies, owner transition, cross-tenant conflict, prior-module activation governance and platform correction. Escalation uses M00 work.

Requirement_Register.title: Marketplace change notifications
Requirement_Register.statement: M04 produces controlled English and Spanish notifications for draft creation, activation submission and outcome, activation, suspension and reactivation, ending schedule, brand publication, blocked schedule, domain action, domain activation or suspension, product-path disablement, participant enablement or block, referral revocation or replacement, propagation failure and JET override or restoration. M10 later owns final templates and delivery.

Requirement_Register.title: Marketplace history
Requirement_Register.statement: Root and JET administrators review immutable history for creation, lifecycle, brand and content versions, availability, participant and routing, support, domain, publication, links, root actions, JET override, readiness and propagation. History records actual actor, acting organization, before and after, effective date, reason, release, correlation and time. Downlines see only their participation and links.

Requirement_Register.title: Public marketplace entry resolution
Requirement_Register.statement: Public entry may arrive through the active primary domain, approved JET-managed route, valid agency or agent referral or another approved link. Before personal data, M04 resolves and displays marketplace, brand, language, owner, entry attribution, pathways and support. Unknown or invalid routes fail closed with no cross-marketplace or cross-tenant fallback.

Requirement_Register.title: Marketplace home and journey start
Requirement_Register.statement: The public home shows only enabled pathways and does not create a canonical journey merely from a page view. A journey starts after the user selects an enabled path, confirms marketplace or referral context where required and begins the first governed shopping or employer step. M04 supplies release, language, channel, attribution and support to the owning module.

Requirement_Register.title: Deep-link entry
Requirement_Register.statement: A deep link opens a fixed pathway entry only after M04 validates marketplace, route, channel, product, participant or referral, language and readiness. If unavailable, a marketplace-branded state offers only approved explicit alternatives and never silently changes channel, product, marketplace, responsible organization or journey.

Requirement_Register.title: Returning users and existing records
Requirement_Register.statement: A returning user signing in through a marketplace sees only records available in that marketplace and authorized context. A secure record link may return to the original marketplace after identification. Another marketplace does not expose, merge or transfer records. A new referral may offer explicit resume-original, start-new or governed transfer or assistance choice.

Requirement_Register.title: Marketplace operational insights
Requirement_Register.statement: The administration home shows current operational counts for visits, pathway starts, referral entries, consumer, agent and employer starts, no-ready-product results, assistance requests, routing exceptions, publication failures and domain failures without sensitive consumer data. M24 owns historical trends, conversion, attribution analysis and configurable reporting.

Requirement_Register.title: Lean bounded-context implementation
Requirement_Register.statement: Implement M04 as a bounded context within the Lucie modular monolith, separating domain, application, adapter and persistence concerns. A deployment split requires an approved architecture delta.

Requirement_Register.title: Canonical write ownership
Requirement_Register.statement: Only M04 commands may mutate MarketplaceContext, coordinated release, brand, availability, participant, referral, route, support, attribution and marketplace history state. Consumers use versioned APIs, events and read contracts.

Requirement_Register.title: Marketplace release orchestration
Requirement_Register.statement: Coordinate brand, content, availability, participant, routing, support, domain and disclosure versions through a single atomic MarketplaceRelease publication decision.

Requirement_Register.title: Server-side route resolution
Requirement_Register.statement: Resolve domain, route, referral token, marketplace, release, language, participant and responsible organization on the server before personal data collection or protected journey creation.

Requirement_Register.title: No silent fallback architecture
Requirement_Register.statement: Route resolution and availability adapters fail closed and never default to another marketplace, tenant, channel, carrier, participant or journey.

Requirement_Register.title: Compatibility adapters
Requirement_Register.statement: Use versioned adapters for M00, M05 and protected M01. Preserve current baseline behavior until an exact proposed delta is approved, implemented and activated.

Requirement_Register.title: Deployment and activation separation
Requirement_Register.statement: Code deployment does not expose public marketplace behavior. Environment, tenant, marketplace release, route, feature and prior-module delta gates all remain independently enforceable.

Requirement_Register.title: Read-model separation
Requirement_Register.statement: Provide purpose-specific public entry, administration, release comparison, readiness, participant, routing and downstream context read models without direct table access.

Requirement_Register.title: No generalized builders
Requirement_Register.statement: Do not introduce website, CMS, design-token, routing-rule, workflow, product-rule, campaign, dashboard, role or permission builders.

Requirement_Register.title: Environment isolation
Requirement_Register.statement: Local Development, QA, UAT and Production use isolated domains, certificates, credentials, data, search-indexing posture and activation state; production data is not ordinary test data.

Requirement_Register.title: Migration-grade persistence
Requirement_Register.statement: Deliver ordered PostgreSQL migrations with primary and foreign keys, unique and check constraints, indexes, forced row-level security, immutable history and repeatable verification.

Requirement_Register.title: One marketplace per tenant
Requirement_Register.statement: Enforce exactly one canonical MarketplaceContext per tenant and no more than one ACTIVE marketplace release and one ACTIVE primary domain at a time.

Requirement_Register.title: Versioned release components
Requirement_Register.statement: Brand, content, availability, participants, routing, support, domain and disclosure assignments retain immutable version history and are referenced by MarketplaceRelease.

Requirement_Register.title: Effective dates and historical reconstruction
Requirement_Register.statement: Preserve effective periods, source versions and actor provenance for every material configuration and routing decision.

Requirement_Register.title: Referral-token protection
Requirement_Register.statement: Store only cryptographic hashes of referral tokens, issue high-entropy opaque values, support rotation and revocation, and exclude plaintext tokens from logs and events.

Requirement_Register.title: Domain normalization and uniqueness
Requirement_Register.statement: Normalize internationalized hostnames to a controlled ASCII form, enforce platform uniqueness and preserve verification and route history.

Requirement_Register.title: Attribution history
Requirement_Register.statement: Store append-only entry, responsibility, assignment, producer, support, routing reason, consent and effective-date history for each journey.

Requirement_Register.title: Transactional outbox and propagation
Requirement_Register.statement: Commit canonical state, immutable history, M00 audit envelope and outbox event atomically, and track required consumer propagation and reconciliation.

Requirement_Register.title: Sensitive data minimization
Requirement_Register.statement: Marketplace configuration contains no authentication secrets, provider credentials or unnecessary consumer data. Sensitive support and attribution data follows M00 classification and masking.

Requirement_Register.title: Retention and legal hold
Requirement_Register.statement: Apply M00 retention, legal-hold and deletion controls while preserving marketplace, release, disclosure, referral, attribution and transaction evidence.

Requirement_Register.title: Operation-specific OpenAPI
Requirement_Register.statement: Define every M04 operation in OpenAPI 3.1 with a unique request and response schema, stable errors, permission, context, idempotency, concurrency, examples and pagination where applicable.

Requirement_Register.title: Stable bilingual error contract
Requirement_Register.statement: Return machine-readable codes, English and Spanish user-safe messages, field violations, correlation and retry guidance without infrastructure detail.

Requirement_Register.title: Idempotent commands
Requirement_Register.statement: Require an idempotency key for create, publication, schedule, activation, lifecycle, domain, participant, referral, routing, support, import or export and reconciliation commands.

Requirement_Register.title: Optimistic concurrency
Requirement_Register.statement: Require version preconditions for material updates and return the current version and safe conflict guidance when stale.

Requirement_Register.title: Bounded query contracts
Requirement_Register.statement: List and search operations use cursor pagination, deterministic ordering, approved filters and authorization before counts or results are calculated.

Requirement_Register.title: AsyncAPI event-specific contracts
Requirement_Register.statement: Define each material event in AsyncAPI 3.0 with an event-specific strict schema, version, owner, partition key, provenance, compatibility and consumers.

Requirement_Register.title: At-least-once delivery
Requirement_Register.statement: Publish through a transactional outbox; consumers are idempotent, aggregate-ordered, duplicate-tolerant and support dead-letter and reconciliation.

Requirement_Register.title: Schema compatibility
Requirement_Register.statement: Maintain backward compatibility within a major contract version. Breaking changes require a new version, migration, consumer impact analysis and approval.

Requirement_Register.title: Route and token verification
Requirement_Register.statement: Validate hostname and referral-token authenticity, status, marketplace association, participant readiness and expiration before deriving entry context.

Requirement_Register.title: Preview isolation
Requirement_Register.statement: Preview endpoints and contexts are nonproduction, non-indexed and incapable of creating canonical consumers, quotes, applications, messages, assignments, signatures or handoffs.

Requirement_Register.title: Deny-by-default administration
Requirement_Register.statement: Every administration operation requires an explicit M00 permission, active tenant and owner, root or downline scope and a current MarketplaceContext policy decision.

Requirement_Register.title: Public route isolation
Requirement_Register.statement: Hostname, service route and referral token resolve to exactly one tenant and marketplace; ambiguity or mismatch is denied before user data or session context is accepted.

Requirement_Register.title: Open redirect prevention
Requirement_Register.statement: M04 uses allowlisted internal route identifiers and verified domains and never accepts arbitrary post-authentication or error redirect URLs.

Requirement_Register.title: Referral links are attribution-only
Requirement_Register.statement: Referral tokens cannot authenticate, authorize, expose records, bypass consent or grant participant eligibility.

Requirement_Register.title: Immediate participant revocation
Requirement_Register.statement: Participant, organization, relationship, agent, route or link suspension invalidates new entry and active privileged contexts without requiring manual sign-out.

Requirement_Register.title: No production impersonation
Requirement_Register.statement: JET and root preview and administration retain actual identity and explicit context and never create hidden participant sessions.

Requirement_Register.title: Privileged action step-up
Requirement_Register.statement: Require recent authentication or MFA for initial activation, domain activation, owner transition, marketplace ending, sensitive export, JET override and emergency routing changes.

Requirement_Register.title: Asset and content sanitization
Requirement_Register.statement: Validate file type, dimensions, metadata, malware, safe encoding and content rules; sanitize permitted formatting and prohibit active code, scripts and tracking pixels.

Requirement_Register.title: Domain verification and certificate controls
Requirement_Register.statement: Use JET-controlled verification, certificate lifecycle, route health, DNS revalidation and emergency suspension without exposing infrastructure credentials.

Requirement_Register.title: Enumeration-safe public behavior
Requirement_Register.statement: Invalid domains, links and marketplace IDs return consistent user-safe unavailable responses without confirming tenant or participant existence.

Requirement_Register.title: Audit integrity
Requirement_Register.statement: Audit actual actor, acting organization, selected marketplace and participant, release and route versions, before and after, reason, result, correlation and time in immutable evidence.

Requirement_Register.title: Export and operational insight controls
Requirement_Register.statement: Exports and operational counts are scoped, purpose-limited, masked and audited and do not expose consumer details or other tenants.

Requirement_Register.title: Complete requirement traceability
Requirement_Register.statement: Every requirement links to three acceptance criteria, governed tests, implementation tasks, interfaces, objects and any prior-module delta.

Requirement_Register.title: English and Spanish parity testing
Requirement_Register.statement: Test every activated public and administrative screen, validation, notification, unavailable state, support route, disclosure and release message in English and Spanish.

Requirement_Register.title: WCAG 2.2 AA acceptance
Requirement_Register.statement: Verify keyboard, focus, screen reader, contrast, text resizing, responsive layout, language metadata, non-color status, accessible assets, tables, dialogs and error recovery.

Requirement_Register.title: Route and referral security matrix
Requirement_Register.statement: Test valid, invalid, expired, revoked, cross-tenant, wrong-participant, suspended and replayed route and referral combinations.

Requirement_Register.title: Availability composition tests
Requirement_Register.statement: Exercise every source dependency and prove M04 composes status without overriding M00, M03, M05, M06, M08, M20, M21 or M26 authority.

Requirement_Register.title: Publication atomicity tests
