Requirement_Register.statement: Prove coordinated releases publish all referenced versions or none, scheduled publication revalidates, and blocked publication preserves the active release.

Requirement_Register.title: Migration verification
Requirement_Register.statement: Apply seven ordered migrations from empty and supported prior state, verify keys, constraints, indexes, RLS, immutable history, views and forward-fix or rollback.

Requirement_Register.title: Event and consumer contract tests
Requirement_Register.statement: Validate every event schema and fixture, duplicate and retry behavior, consumer idempotency, ordered aggregate processing, dead-letter and reconciliation.

Requirement_Register.title: Performance and cache invalidation
Requirement_Register.statement: Establish public route, home, availability, preview and administration performance targets and prove release, route, participant and product changes invalidate stale cache safely.

Requirement_Register.title: Resilience and continuity testing
Requirement_Register.statement: Exercise domain, certificate, product, participant, queue and downstream failure while preserving current release, existing records and user-safe next actions.

Requirement_Register.title: Search indexing controls
Requirement_Register.statement: Prove draft, preview, suspended, invalid and retired routes cannot be indexed and active indexing follows JET-controlled policy.

Requirement_Register.title: Operational telemetry
Requirement_Register.statement: Emit structured metrics, logs and traces for route resolution, availability, publication, domain, referral, routing, participant, propagation and override without sensitive payloads.

Requirement_Register.title: Backup and recovery
Requirement_Register.statement: Test backup, point-in-time recovery, route and release restoration, outbox reconciliation and historical evidence preservation.

Requirement_Register.title: Prior-module regression gate
Requirement_Register.statement: No release passes while any M00, M05 or protected M01 impact lacks a reverse-linked disposition, compatibility, rollback, regression and approval status.

Requirement_Register.title: Runbook rehearsal
Requirement_Register.statement: Rehearse route failure, domain incident, publication block, participant loss, referral compromise, product unavailability, propagation failure, suspension, ending and prior-module rollback.

Requirement_Register.title: AI implementation controls
Requirement_Register.statement: AI-assisted implementation cites stable IDs, consumes governed contracts, does not invent white-label or routing scope and requires human review for legal, security, privacy, content and delta decisions.

Risk_Register.title: Cross-tenant route resolution
Risk_Register.description: A hostname or token could resolve to another tenant.
Risk_Register.mitigation: Unique normalized domains, hashed tokens, server context and negative tests.
Risk_Register.owner: M04 Product, Engineering, Security, UX and Operations

Risk_Register.title: Silent marketplace fallback
Risk_Register.description: Unavailable routes could accidentally land in JET or another agency.
Risk_Register.mitigation: Fail-closed resolver and explicit alternatives only.
Risk_Register.owner: M04 Product, Engineering, Security, UX and Operations

Risk_Register.title: Referral link treated as authorization
Risk_Register.description: A link could expose existing records.
Risk_Register.mitigation: Attribution-only contract, authentication and explicit consent or assignment.
Risk_Register.owner: M04 Product, Engineering, Security, UX and Operations

Risk_Register.title: Stale participant routing
Risk_Register.description: Suspended agency or agent could continue receiving work.
Risk_Register.mitigation: Dependency events, immediate invalidation, reauthorization and monitoring.
Risk_Register.owner: M04 Product, Engineering, Security, UX and Operations

Risk_Register.title: Marketplace release inconsistency
Risk_Register.description: Brand, availability and routing could publish different versions.
Risk_Register.mitigation: Atomic coordinated release and publication transaction.
Risk_Register.owner: M04 Product, Engineering, Security, UX and Operations

Risk_Register.title: Bilingual content gap
Risk_Register.description: Spanish users could enter incomplete or misleading flows.
Risk_Register.mitigation: Field-level parity validation and activation gate.
Risk_Register.owner: M04 Product, Engineering, Security, UX and Operations

Risk_Register.title: Accessibility regression from branding
Risk_Register.description: Agency colors or assets could make the storefront unusable.
Risk_Register.mitigation: Derived accessible tokens, validation and visual regression.
Risk_Register.owner: M04 Product, Engineering, Security, UX and Operations

Risk_Register.title: Misleading white label
Risk_Register.description: Content could imply government, carrier or Exchange status.
Risk_Register.mitigation: Content rules, JET block and approved legal attribution.
Risk_Register.owner: M04 Product, Engineering, Security, UX and Operations

Risk_Register.title: Domain takeover or expiry
Risk_Register.description: A custom domain could point incorrectly or expire.
Risk_Register.mitigation: Ownership verification, periodic health, certificate monitoring and emergency suspension.
Risk_Register.owner: M04 Product, Engineering, Security, UX and Operations

Risk_Register.title: Open redirect or phishing
Risk_Register.description: Custom redirect targets could send users outside the governed marketplace.
Risk_Register.mitigation: Internal route identifiers and verified-domain allowlists.
Risk_Register.owner: M04 Product, Engineering, Security, UX and Operations

Risk_Register.title: Stale product availability
Risk_Register.description: Users could see unavailable carriers or plans.
Risk_Register.mitigation: Source readiness composition, cache invalidation and no-ready-products behavior.
Risk_Register.owner: M04 Product, Engineering, Security, UX and Operations

Risk_Register.title: Plan ranking bias
Risk_Register.mitigation: No individual plan ranking or sponsorship in M04.
Risk_Register.owner: M04 Product, Engineering, Security, UX and Operations

Risk_Register.title: Agent eligibility drift
Risk_Register.description: Referral or assignment could outlive affiliation or sellability.
Risk_Register.mitigation: M06 and M08 eligibility checks, events and immediate link invalidation.
Risk_Register.owner: M04 Product, Engineering, Security, UX and Operations

Risk_Register.title: Prior-module divergence
Risk_Register.description: M04 could silently change M00, M05 or M01.
Risk_Register.mitigation: Reverse-linked append-only delta gates and cumulative regression.
Risk_Register.owner: M04 Product, Engineering, Security, UX and Operations

Risk_Register.title: Historical evidence rewrite
Risk_Register.description: Rebrand or reassignment could alter earlier transaction evidence.
Risk_Register.owner: M04 Product, Engineering, Security, UX and Operations

Risk_Register.title: Preview production leakage
Risk_Register.description: Preview could create real business records or become indexed.
Risk_Register.mitigation: Separate preview context, write denylist and indexing controls.
Risk_Register.owner: M04 Product, Engineering, Security, UX and Operations

Risk_Register.title: Propagation recovery gap
Risk_Register.description: A published release could fail to reach downstream modules.
Risk_Register.mitigation: Per-consumer status, retries, reconciliation and current-release continuity.
Risk_Register.owner: M04 Product, Engineering, Security, UX and Operations

Risk_Register.title: Root support continuity gap
Risk_Register.description: Downline loss could leave consumers without support.
Risk_Register.mitigation: Mandatory root support fallback and continuity runbooks.
Risk_Register.owner: M04 Product, Engineering, Security, UX and Operations

Runbook_Register.title: Initial marketplace provisioning and activation
Runbook_Register.owner: JET Platform Operations
Runbook_Register.trigger: Use this procedure when initial marketplace provisioning and activation is requested or detected.
Runbook_Register.preconditions: ["Confirm environment, tenant, marketplace, active and draft release, actual actor and owner or participant context.", "Confirm authority, feature and prior-module delta activation state and any required step-up authentication.", "Open or link an M00 task, exception or incident and capture a correlation ID."]
Runbook_Register.diagnostics: ["Inspect canonical MarketplaceContext, component versions, readiness, domain and route health, participant state, audit and propagation.", "Confirm whether any public journey, external handoff, signed document or immutable evidence is in scope.", "Identify affected channels, states, products, carriers, participants, routes, consumers and downstream modules."]
Runbook_Register.containment: ["Disable or block new affected entries without moving users to another marketplace or pathway.", "Preserve the current active release, saved work, evidence, route history, events and user-safe continuity.", "Do not edit final evidence, impersonate a participant or publish only part of a coordinated release."]
Runbook_Register.recovery: ["Execute the governed idempotent corrective command or restore a prior valid release or route as a new version.", "Retry only safe operations and reconcile authoritative source-module and downstream status.", "Invalidate stale route, referral, participant, release and public caches and refresh effective authorization."]
Runbook_Register.verification: ["Verify canonical versions, one-active constraints, audit, event delivery, route resolution and downstream acceptance.", "Run targeted route, referral, bilingual, accessibility, availability and prior-module regression scenarios.", "Confirm public user-safe state, existing-record continuity and primary support route."]
Runbook_Register.communications: ["Notify affected root and downline administrators using approved English and Spanish templates.", "Provide users with accurate impact, saved-work status, explicit next action and support route.", "Escalate legal, security, privacy, domain, content or release decisions to accountable owners."]
Runbook_Register.evidence: ["Task or incident ID, actor and context, reason, before and after, versions, time and correlation.", "API, migration, route, certificate, event, test and approval evidence.", "Closure, follow-up owner and change or delta record where required."]

User_Flow_Register.name: Initial marketplace setup and activation
User_Flow_Register.summary: Root completes identity, brand, content, support, availability, participants, route, preview and readiness and submits the first release to JET.
User_Flow_Register.accessibility: Every step meets WCAG 2.2 AA and preserves focus, status announcements and explicit context.

User_Flow_Register.name: Publish an ordinary brand change
User_Flow_Register.summary: Root edits both languages and assets, previews, compares and publishes a low-risk coordinated release.
User_Flow_Register.accessibility: Every step meets WCAG 2.2 AA and preserves focus, status announcements and explicit context.

User_Flow_Register.name: Schedule a marketplace release
User_Flow_Register.summary: Root schedules one future coordinated release and handles readiness failure without partial publication.
User_Flow_Register.accessibility: Every step meets WCAG 2.2 AA and preserves focus, status announcements and explicit context.

User_Flow_Register.name: Request and activate a custom domain
User_Flow_Register.summary: Root proves domain control, JET verifies and activates, and prior route continuity is preserved.
User_Flow_Register.accessibility: Every step meets WCAG 2.2 AA and preserves focus, status announcements and explicit context.

User_Flow_Register.name: Configure state product carrier availability
User_Flow_Register.summary: Root configures the fixed matrix and reviews source blockers before release.
User_Flow_Register.accessibility: Every step meets WCAG 2.2 AA and preserves focus, status announcements and explicit context.

User_Flow_Register.name: Enable a direct downline participant
User_Flow_Register.summary: Root reviews M05 state and readiness, enables channels, support and link posture and publishes the release.
User_Flow_Register.accessibility: Every step meets WCAG 2.2 AA and preserves focus, status announcements and explicit context.

User_Flow_Register.name: Create a downline referral link
User_Flow_Register.summary: Root or downline creates an attribution-only link on the shared marketplace domain and verifies public entry.
User_Flow_Register.accessibility: Every step meets WCAG 2.2 AA and preserves focus, status announcements and explicit context.

User_Flow_Register.name: Create an agent referral link
User_Flow_Register.summary: Authorized administrator creates a link for an eligible M06 and M08-confirmed agent.
User_Flow_Register.accessibility: Every step meets WCAG 2.2 AA and preserves focus, status announcements and explicit context.

User_Flow_Register.name: Enter through normal public domain
User_Flow_Register.summary: M04 resolves marketplace and release and presents only currently enabled pathways before personal data.
User_Flow_Register.accessibility: Every step meets WCAG 2.2 AA and preserves focus, status announcements and explicit context.

User_Flow_Register.name: Enter through participant referral
User_Flow_Register.summary: M04 resolves link, displays agency or agent context and creates no record until explicit new-journey confirmation.
User_Flow_Register.accessibility: Every step meets WCAG 2.2 AA and preserves focus, status announcements and explicit context.

User_Flow_Register.name: Returning user enters a different referral context
User_Flow_Register.summary: The user explicitly resumes the original journey, starts a new one or requests a governed transfer.
User_Flow_Register.accessibility: Every step meets WCAG 2.2 AA and preserves focus, status announcements and explicit context.

User_Flow_Register.name: Named agent becomes unavailable
User_Flow_Register.summary: New routing stops and the consumer explicitly selects an approved alternative.
User_Flow_Register.accessibility: Every step meets WCAG 2.2 AA and preserves focus, status announcements and explicit context.

User_Flow_Register.name: No ready products
User_Flow_Register.summary: The consumer receives a clear no-options result and only explicit safe alternatives.
User_Flow_Register.accessibility: Every step meets WCAG 2.2 AA and preserves focus, status announcements and explicit context.

User_Flow_Register.name: Suspend and reactivate the marketplace
User_Flow_Register.summary: Root or JET reviews continuity, suspends new starts and later reactivates after readiness.
User_Flow_Register.accessibility: Every step meets WCAG 2.2 AA and preserves focus, status announcements and explicit context.

User_Flow_Register.name: End a marketplace
User_Flow_Register.summary: Root requests ending and JET completes offboarding, route, participant and historical continuity.
User_Flow_Register.accessibility: Every step meets WCAG 2.2 AA and preserves focus, status announcements and explicit context.

User_Flow_Register.name: Suspend a participant
User_Flow_Register.summary: Root stops new routing and links, reviews open work and preserves attribution.
User_Flow_Register.accessibility: Every step meets WCAG 2.2 AA and preserves focus, status announcements and explicit context.

User_Flow_Register.name: Reassign eligible open marketplace work
User_Flow_Register.summary: Root selects a new organization or eligible agent with consent and history while final records remain protected.
User_Flow_Register.accessibility: Every step meets WCAG 2.2 AA and preserves focus, status announcements and explicit context.

User_Flow_Register.name: Resolve a route or publication failure
User_Flow_Register.summary: JET inspects health and correlation, restores the active release or prior route and reconciles propagation.
User_Flow_Register.accessibility: Every step meets WCAG 2.2 AA and preserves focus, status announcements and explicit context.

User_Flow_Register.name: Preview participant and failure states
User_Flow_Register.summary: Root previews downline, agent, suspended and unavailable scenarios in both languages and supported devices.
User_Flow_Register.accessibility: Every step meets WCAG 2.2 AA and preserves focus, status announcements and explicit context.

User_Flow_Register.name: Review and approve a prior-module delta
User_Flow_Register.summary: Accountable owners review M00, M05 or protected M01 impacts without changing the baseline until approval.
User_Flow_Register.accessibility: Every step meets WCAG 2.2 AA and preserves focus, status announcements and explicit context.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Marketplace Required
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: marketplace_id is required and must match server-resolved tenant and route context.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Tenant Required
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: tenant_id is required and must match M00 context.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Owner Mismatch
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: marketplace owner must equal the M05 effective tenant owner.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Duplicate Marketplace
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: a tenant cannot have a second canonical marketplace.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Marketplace State Conflict
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: marketplace lifecycle transition must be valid.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Ended Terminal
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: an ended marketplace cannot be routinely reactivated.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Release Required
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: public entry and journey creation require an active coordinated release.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Multiple Active Release
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: a marketplace cannot have more than one active release.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Multiple Draft Release
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: a marketplace cannot have more than one editable draft release.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Release Component Missing
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: a coordinated release must reference every required component version.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Release Component Not Valid
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: every referenced component version must pass validation.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Release Readiness Failed
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: publication is blocked when readiness is not acceptable.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Release Schedule Conflict
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: only one future release may be scheduled.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Release Stale
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: publication requires the current component and release versions.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Language Incomplete
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: every root-configurable field requires English and Spanish.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Legal Content Unapproved
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: controlled legal content must reference an approved library item and version.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Asset Type Invalid
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: asset type must be one of the fixed Lucie marketplace types.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Asset Media Invalid
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: asset media type, dimensions and size must meet governed limits.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Asset Scan Failed
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: rejected or unscanned asset cannot be published.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Color Inaccessible
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: selected primary and accent colors must pass accessibility derivation.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Custom Font Prohibited
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: custom font configuration is prohibited.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Active Content Prohibited
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: scripts, active code, tracking pixels and unsupported markup are prohibited.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Domain Required
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: an active public marketplace requires one active primary domain.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Domain Invalid
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: domain must normalize to a valid allowed hostname.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Domain Duplicate
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: a public domain cannot map to another marketplace or tenant.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Domain Unverified
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: custom domain cannot activate before ownership verification.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Domain Health Failed
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: domain cannot activate when DNS, certificate or route health fails.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Domain Multiple Active
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: only one primary domain may be active.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Route Not Found
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: unknown route fails closed.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Route Ambiguous
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: ambiguous route fails closed and requires JET correction.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Route Marketplace Mismatch
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: route and submitted marketplace context must match.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Open Redirect Prohibited
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: arbitrary redirect targets are prohibited.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Channel Not Entitled
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: root cannot enable an unentitled or inactive channel.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Product Line Invalid
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: product line must be one of the fixed Lucie values.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Product Not Entitled
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: root cannot enable an unentitled product line.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: State Not Approved
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: state must be in the JET-approved tenant launch list.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Carrier Not Ready
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: carrier cannot be enabled without JET-controlled identity and ready product data.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Plan Level Config Prohibited
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: M04 cannot curate individual plans.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Availability Source Blocked
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: any required source blocker makes the pathway unavailable.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: No Silent Fallback
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: unavailable pathway cannot change marketplace, channel, product, carrier or participant automatically.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Participant Not Direct Downline
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: non-root participant must be an active M05 direct downline.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Participant M05 Inactive
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: inactive organization or relationship blocks participation.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Participant Admin Required
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: participant readiness requires an active administrator.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Participant Already Exists
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: an organization may have only one current participant record per marketplace.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Participant Channel Invalid
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: participant cannot enable a channel unavailable to the marketplace.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Agent Not Eligible
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: agent referral or assignment requires current M06 and M08 eligibility.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Referral Token Required
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: referral resolution requires a valid opaque token.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Referral Token Invalid
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: invalid, expired, revoked or suspended referral fails safely.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Referral Marketplace Mismatch
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: referral must belong to the resolved marketplace.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Referral Not Authorization
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: referral context cannot grant record access.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Existing Journey Precedence
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: existing active journey cannot be silently reassigned by referral.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: New Journey Confirmation Required
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: signed-in new journey under changed referral requires explicit confirmation.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Responsible Organization Required
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: a canonical journey requires a responsible organization.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Reassignment Final Record
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: final or externally submitted record cannot use ordinary reassignment.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Reassignment Scope Invalid
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: new organization or agent must be inside authorized root or downline scope.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Consent Required
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: assistance or existing-record access requires applicable authorization.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Support Required
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: active marketplace requires complete bilingual root support.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Support Stale
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: inactive participant support cannot be displayed.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Preview Production Write
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: preview may not create production business records.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Preview Indexing Prohibited
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: preview route cannot be indexed.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Indexing Jet Approval Required
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: public indexing requires JET-controlled enablement.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Export Purpose Required
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: export requires an approved purpose and field set.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Export Scope Invalid
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: export cannot include another marketplace, tenant or unauthorized participant.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Version Conflict
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: material update requires current version precondition.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Idempotency Required
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: governed mutation requires idempotency key.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Propagation Pending
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: downstream pending cannot be displayed as complete.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: History Immutable
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: marketplace and attribution history cannot be edited or deleted through application APIs.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Delta Not Approved
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: affected M00, M05 or M01 behavior cannot activate before exact delta approval.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Public Personal Data Early
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: personal information cannot be requested before valid marketplace entry resolution.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Search Metadata Incomplete
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: indexable metadata requires both languages and approved preview image where configured.
